tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub thob me long rdo rje'i rnam thar

dri log ma bzhugs so/ / āoṃ āḥhūṃ/ /chos sku'i bla ma dmigs med ngang*/ /longs sku'i bla ma 'od gsal sku/ /sprul sku'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dug gsum grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyings bla ma mi rtog dang*/ /me long bla ma gsal dag lha/ /mnyam nyid bla ma mtho dma' med// sor rtogs bla ma ma 'dres gsal/ /bya grub bla ma rigs 'khor bcas/ /bla ma lnga la gsol ba 'debs/ /dug lnga grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byin rlabs rtogs pas 'khor mdzad bla ma dang*/ /bsgrubs pas dngos grub 'byung ba yi dam lha/ /'ur bas gzhan snang thul ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig rjes 'jug thugs rjes zungs/ / mos pas thugs dgongs gcig gyur chos mdzad dang*/ /rtogs pas dgongs don grol ba dam pa'i chos/ /dam tshig gtsang bas bsgrubs pa'i chos skyong rnams/ /bstan pa srungs shig bar chad rkyen rnams sol/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyen swā hā/ sgrags nang rtug pa me long la/ /'phreng po'i ston pa dbang phyug khong*/ /dri log rnam thar zhuu 'o zer/ /shog bur 'chal gtam kha gcig longs/ / oṃ ā ཿhūm̐/ de ltar nyon mongs pa dmigs su med pa chos sku me long gi rnam thar/ rang rgyud rtsub la stong pa chos sku me long gi rnam thar/ 'dus 'du shes la mtha' dang bral ba chos sku me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum chos sku me long gi rnam thar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtha' bral gcig tu bsdus pa longs sku me long gi rnam thar gcig gi stong pa ye shes lnga mdangs dang ldan pa longs sku me long gi rnam thar/ cang med zhi khro sku ru gsal ba longs sku me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum longs sku me long gi rnam thar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma byin par gzhan gyi chung ma la rku ba sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ mi tshangs pa rang gi bu mo la spyod pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/

rdzun bla ma la gtong ba sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ srog gcod rang gi bu phrug gsod pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ 'grogs gzhung yon bdag dang rtsod pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ mje a ma la ston pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ mi ngas chung ma la byed pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ rang re'i bla ma rang res chog pa sprul sku me long gi rnam thar/ de rnams sprul sku me long gi rnam thar bsdus pa'o/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rnams dang rmi lam du mjal ba rdzun rkyal me long gi rnam thar/ bstan gtso dang thugs rje chen po dang phag mo dang lhan skyes dang rta mgrin rnams kyi zhal mthong ba rdzun rkyal me long gi rnam thar/ rdzogs pa chen po snying tig zab pa'i yon tan gyis bdag dang 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa rdzun rkyal me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum rdzun rkyal me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo la rdog rjes bdun brgyad byung ba zog po me long gi rnam thar/ brag rgod mche ba la g.yung drung ris dang lag rjes rgyab pa zog po me long gi rnam thar/ rmong spus rgyal bsen thub pa zog po me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum zog po me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ rtag tu 'chi ba dran pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ bla ma mtshan ldan 'tshol ba chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ mos gus gsol ba 'debs pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ rgyu 'bras la thub tshad 'dzem pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ dag snang btub tshad kyis sbyangs pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ bla ma phyogs med la mos gus byed pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ gdams ngag zab mo zhu ba chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ de tsho la las 'brel du ma re 'jog pa chos pa me long gi rnam thar/ de rnams chos pa me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhen log dgos med du 'byongs pa'i ri khrod me long gi rnam thar/ dben gnas brag phug 'dzin pa ri khrod me long gi rnam thar/ 'phong la tsher ma zugs pa bzhin byed pa ri khrod me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum ri khrod me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dka' thub sna tshogs byed pa ltogs brkam me long gi rnam thar/ ras rkyang gyon zhing khyi lpags 'ding ba ltogs brkam me long gi rnam thar/ bla ma rnams la gdams ngag zhu ba'i phyag rten dang tshogs 'khor ngu ba la byed pa ltogs brkam me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum ltogs brkam me long gi rnam thar ro/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya nad dang shig nad zhugs pa dbang chung me long gi rnam thar/ slong mos bzhad gang du gyur pa dbang chung me long gi rnam thar/ rngan chen rgyun chad med pa dbang chung me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum dbang chung me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi thugs rjes bzung ba grub thob me long gi rnam thar/ mi 'gyur phag mos bcug pa grub thob me long gi rnam thar/ dus ngan gyi snang ba bde shos su 'dug pa grub thob me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum grub thob me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngo bo stong nyid du rtogs pa rtogs ldan me long gi rnam thar/ rang bzhin ye shes lnga ldan du rtogs pa rtogs ldan me long gi rnam thar/ thugs rjes sku gsum kun khyab tu rtogs pa rtogs ldan me long gi rnam thar/ de gsum rtogs ldan me long gi rnam thar ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /rang gi ngo bo rtogs par mdzod/ /longs sku me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /rang gi rang bzhin rtogs par mdzod/ sprul sku me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /mtshang ngan phyi ru phyin par mdzod/ /rdzun rkyal me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /nga rgyal dbyings su dag par mdzod/ /zog po me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /chags sdang rang sar dag par mdzod/

/chos pa me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /mi tshe bzang la skyol bar mdzod/ /ri khrod me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /zhen chags gting nas med par mdzod/ /ltog brkam me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /chos phyogs sdug bsran thub par mdzod/ grub thob me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /gang yin mgo ni thon par mdzod/ /rtog ldan me long gi rnam thar gyis/ /sangs rgyas tshe 'dir 'grub par mdzod/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprang po me long rdo rje yi/ /rnam thar bcu gcig brtsam yig ma/ /ston pa dbang phyug thugs dgyes mdzod/ / sgrags nang rtug pa me long gi rnam thar dri log ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // shubham̐/ dza antu// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)grub thob me long rdo rje'i rnam thar dri log ma/ -PAGE 142--PAGE 143--PAGE 141-
